title: Neurosurgery & Spine Treatments in India
headline: Advanced Brain & Spine Care with World-Class Surgeons
introduction: India is one of the most preferred destinations for neurosurgery & spine care, offering state-of-the-art technology, highly skilled neurosurgeons, and 70–85% lower costs compared to the USA, UK, or UAE. From minimally invasive brain surgery to complex spine reconstruction, India provides safe, affordable, and internationally accredited care.
